settings.title: General Settings

chain.loudnessDesc: Automatically aligns the perceived volume between clips (loudness EBU R128), with a static gain — no compression, no pumping.
chain.loudnessHint: Measured once per clip (in the background) and saved in the project. Gain limited to ±9 dB. Default: -16 LUFS.
chain.pipelineDesc: Broadcast-grade pipeline: HPF → Multiband Glue → brickwall Limiter on the master bus.
chain.hpfHint: Removes rumble, low hiss, DC offset. Default: 30 Hz (preserves the warmth of the bass).
chain.glueDesc: 3-band compressor (low/mid/high) with a gently tuned preset: aligns the dynamics and adds warmth without raising the volume or hardening the sound. When off, the signal passes clean (only HPF + safety Limiter).
chain.styleHint: Only 'Neutral' is tuned with objective measurement (LUFS/LRA). The other styles are starting values: verify in broadcast with real listening.
chain.limiterAlways: Always active if chain is enabled
chain.limiterHint: Absolute block for transmitter protection. 20:1, 2 ms att. Default: -1 dBFS.

settings.languageHelp: Select the interface language. The change is applied immediately.
settings.remoteControlDesc: Local network (LAN) server to control the app from a tablet or secondary PC: STOP ALL and play/stop of the Music column.
settings.remoteControlHint: Open the link in the browser of the tablet or secondary PC (same network) and enter the PIN; the "Fullscreen" button on the page hides the browser bar. It's handy to send the link via Telegram/WhatsApp instead of typing it by hand. The server stops automatically when the app is closed.
settings.layoutColumnsDesc: Enable or disable the columns shown in the board according to the needs of the broadcast. Global preference (applies to all projects). Hiding a column does NOT delete its clips: they stay in the project and reappear when you re-enable it. FX have their own dedicated pad.
settings.outputDeviceHelp: Select the audio device (e.g. Rødecaster). The audio switches immediately.
settings.duckingReductionHelp: Music volume when the speaker talks. 20% is the radio-broadcast standard.
settings.transitionSegue: Segue / Cold Start (Instantly Full, Previous Fades Out)
settings.transitionHelp: Automatic transition between consecutive clips with play_next.
settings.smartMicDesc: The microphone monitors speech and automatically lowers the music, without going through a voice clip.
settings.micInputDeviceHelp: USB microphone, Rødecaster, Zoom LiveTrak, Focusrite, etc. appear here automatically.
settings.micThresholdHelp: Release at {{v}} dBFS (fixed 12 dB hysteresis). Default: -30 dBFS.
settings.micActivationHoldLabel: Activation hold (ms above threshold before ducking)
settings.micReleaseHoldLabel: Release hold (ms below threshold before ducking stops)
settings.micHoldHelp: With USB mixers (Rødecaster, Zoom LiveTrak, etc.) that loop back the PC audio, raise the threshold to -20/-15 dBFS or increase the activation hold to 200–500 ms to avoid triggers from unintended bleed.
settings.micMixDesc: Sends the operator's voice directly to the application's master bus.
settings.micBypassOn: ⚠️ Raw voice at the output (zero latency, no effects).
settings.micFeedbackAck: Feedback risk: use headphones or a professional mixer.
settings.micFeedbackWarnPart1: If you use speakers, the mic audio may re-enter the mix and create howling. Always use
settings.micFeedbackWarnPart2: when the Mix channel is active. Professional mixers (Rødecaster, etc.) with internal routing don't have this risk.
settings.micFeedbackConfirm: Understood. I use headphones or a professional mixer.
settings.recordingDesc: The recording captures everything you hear at the output — including the microphone (if armed and in mix) and master effects. The format and quality are chosen at export time.
settings.recordingTapHint: The recorded signal is faithful to the on-air sound: it passes through HPF, Compressor and brickwall Limiter.
settings.recordingDefaultFormatHelp: Format preselected when the export window opens.

rotation.title: PRE-SHOW Rotation
rotation.intro: During the PRE-SHOW it randomly inserts clips from the Jingle/Promo columns, at the end of a track and never overlapping. It doesn't touch the show, only the filler.
rotation.help: The counters reset at every STOP ALL. An empty column is skipped. If jingle and promo coincide on the same track, they are played in sequence.
